headline: Granted one parking ticket appeal and denied another; both votes were unanimous.
summary: Laz Parking presented its parking payment options, which rely on QR codes. The mayor reported no parking issues downtown so far. Two parking ticket appeals were decided, and monthly parking ticket reports were reviewed.
decisions: Approved the June 6th 2026 meeting minutes; vote was unanimous.
Granted the appeal of Tim Thompson's No Parking Zone ticket #105503; vote was unanimous.
Denied the appeal of Charisma Tanguay's No Parking Zone ticket #105998; vote was unanimous.

plain_text:
City of Bristol 
PARKING AUTHORITY 
August 3rd 2026  
111 North Main Street 
Bristol, CT 06010 
 
 
PRESENT:     ABSENT:      
Chairperson Andrea Adams   Eric Bonaiuti  
James Driscoll Jr     
Michael Massarelli      
Michael Petosa 
Amy Lowrey 
 
STAFF PRESENT: 
Mayor Ellen Zoppo-Sassu 
 
1. CALL TO ORDER 
Chairperson Andrea Adams called the Parking Authority Meeting to order at 6:30 pm. 
 
Mike Massarelli made a motion to move agenda item #2 to item #5, seconded by James 
Driscoll Jr. 
  Vote: Unanimously Passed 
 
2. APPROVAL OF MINUTES 
Michael Massarelli made a motion to approve the June 6th 2026 meeting minutes, 
seconded by Michael Petosa.    
Vote: Unanimously Passed 
 
3. PARKING APP PRESENTATION 
John Santaniello general manager at Laz Parking spoke to the committee about what Laz 
Parking has to offer the City of Bristol. Laz works mostly off QR codes posted in parking 
garages or street parking for paid street parking. They do offer kiosks for people to pay 
at. John spoke on how they are getting away from using parking meters and have 
completely phased out the app, stating QR codes are the most efficient way for people to 
pay. The committee had further discussion with John about payment, enforcement, and 
what other cities are doing.  
 
Mayor Ellen Zoppo-Sassu spoke to the committee after the presentation and stated that at 
this time there have been no issues with parking downtown. There will be new signage 
posted to advertise the parking garage on Hope Street and a marketing video posted to 
social media explaining where people can park.  
 
4. PARKING TICKET APPEALS 
The Parking Authority heard the following parking ticket appeals.
Name: Tim Thompson  
Date ticket was issued: 04/25/2026  
Violation: No Parking Zone 
Ticket #105503 
Michael Massarelli made a motion to grant the appeal, second by Michael Petosa.  
Vote: Unanimously Passed 
 
Name: Charisma Tanguay  
Date ticket was issued: 07/20/226 
Violation: No Parking Zone   
Ticket # 105998 
Michael Massarelli made a motion to deny the appeal, second by James Driscoll Jr.  
Vote: Unanimously Passed 
   
5. NEW BUSINESS 
 
a. Review Monthly Reports  
The committee reviewed and discussed the monthly parking ticket reports.  
 
6. OLD BUSINESS 
NONE 
 
7. ADJOURNMENT 
Michael Massarelli made a motion to adjourn, second by Michael Petosa 
Vote: Unanimously Passed 
The Parking Authority meeting for the 3rd day of August was hereby adjourned at 
7:20pm. 
Jacqueline England   
Recording Secretary
